scoring.notes: Coding sector component; the page's 2026-08-13 v2 update calls Code Migration "A private benchmark involving porting projects to a set of four languages, including COBOL modernization". Its Component Scores note states that the index scores a fixed subset of the published run — 50 of the 120 CLI migration tasks plus all 10 COBOL tasks, weighted 75% CLI and 25% COBOL — and not the full standalone run. The page reports these columns under its "ACCURACY" view (heading "Industry Average Accuracy Comparison") and prints index values as percentages in its Key Takeaways.

description: Porting projects to another language, including COBOL modernization.
